title: New Dundee Road sewer and watermain referral
subtitle: Write-offs, neighbourhood association affiliation, community grants, Great Places Awards changes and 2024 drinking water reports.
overview: The Finance and Corporate Services Committee spent most of its short meeting on a proposed local improvement to build a sanitary sewer and watermain on New Dundee Road. The committee recommended referring the matter to the March 3, 2025 Council meeting so the Ward Councillor can talk further with owners of the affected properties {{vote:m8}}. Staff cautioned that a longer delay would not be recommended, because the work is meant to line up with the Region of Waterloo's reconstruction of the road.

The committee also recommended a package of routine financial and community items. These include writing off uncollectable miscellaneous accounts {{vote:m1}} and utility accounts {{vote:m2}}, affiliating the proposed neighbourhood associations for 2025 {{vote:m3}}, and approving Tier 2 community grants totalling $233,653 {{vote:m4}}. It also endorsed changes to the Great Places Awards program {{vote:m5}}.

The committee received the 2024 drinking water management review {{vote:m6}} and the 2024 summary drinking water report {{vote:m7}} for information. A report on the Belmont BIA boundary expansion was presented for information only. Council will consider the recommendations later.

decisions.detail: The committee recommended referring the sewer and watermain local improvement by-law to the March 3, 2025 Council meeting so the Ward Councillor can speak further with affected property owners.
The committee recommended approving Tier 2 community grants totalling $233,653.
The committee recommended approving the listed neighbourhood associations for 2025 affiliation and adding them to the City's third-party liability insurance program.
The committee recommended writing off $101,518 in uncollectable utility accounts against the allowance for doubtful utility receivables.
The committee recommended writing off $28,642 in uncollectable miscellaneous receivable accounts.
The committee recommended endorsing the proposed amendments to Kitchener's Great Places Awards program.
The committee received the report for information and directed that copies go to the Township of Woolwich and the City of Waterloo.
